scene.head: with_body
scene.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a rooftop open-air listening lounge at dusk with a low sofa and an urban skyline — leaning forward to listen closely to a vinyl record while holding its plain inner sleeve on her knees; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — dries her hair with a towel; a quiet sleeper-train compartment at sunrise — waking slowly and stretching a soft slipper toward the floor while listening to music from a small speaker; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — chest-deep in the water; an old stone chapel lit by candles — standing; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — standing; a hot-spring town footbath under a wooden roof — holds her keepsake at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — sitting on the ground; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing
